title: Outbuilding area, ridge height and location per Table 2.6a
text: C2.6.1 Any outbuilding is provided in accordance with Table 2.6a, provided that it: i. is set back or built up to lot boundaries in accordance with C3.4.1, C3.4.5 or C3.4.6; ii. does not exceed the maximum allowable site cover in accordance with C3.1.1; iii. does not reduce the minimum outdoor living area or primary garden area required in accordance with C1.1.1 or C1.1.3; iv. does not reduce the minimum soft landscaping required in accordance with C1.2.1; and v. does not reduce the minimum tree provisions and associated deep soil area in accordance with C1.2.3. Table 2.6a Outbuilding provisions: Maximum individual or collective area per site 60m2; Maximum wall height 3m; Maximum ridge height 4.2m; Location: Not located within the primary or secondary street setback area. Refer to Figure 2.6a for wall and ridge height guidance.

replaces.note: lesser-of-60m2-or-10%-of-site cap replaced by 60m2; small-shed category (10m2, 2.7 m) removed

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 2.6a: maximum individual or collective area 60m2 per site; maximum ridge height 4.2 m; not located within the primary or secondary street setback area. Wall height is rule C2.6.1-r1. C2.6.1 also requires that the outbuilding: (i) is set back or built up to lot boundaries per C3.4.1, C3.4.5 or C3.4.6; (ii) does not exceed site cover per C3.1.1; (iii) does not reduce the minimum OLA or PGA per C1.1.1 or C1.1.3; (iv) does not reduce minimum soft landscaping per C1.2.1; (v) does not reduce tree provisions and deep soil per C1.2.3. These cross-references are tested by those rules, not here. Register ch2-030: C3.4.6 does not exist in Chapter 2 (grouped-dwelling clause); C3.4.4 (boundary wall table) is omitted so a shed on a boundary has no clear path; C3.4.3 not referenced. Outbuildings must also meet the NCC (fire separation). Regional LGs may vary 2.6 by LPP without WAPC approval (Ch1 Table 2.5A).
